messages:
carolyn: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem. We need clear owners for the customer-facing comms and a short policy for what RCAs we publish. Can people volunteer?

mike: I can do the 1-2 paragraph customer summary. Draft idea:
"At 14:12 UTC we experienced a partial degradation affecting some hosted inference requests. Traffic was routed to fallback capacity and service recovered by 14:45 UTC. A sanitized summary and next steps will be published within 7 days."

sudha: Good. Call it "partial degradation" not outage. Also capturing recurrence: two prior incidents had slow failover tied to KV cache pressure on a model shard  I'll include pattern notes in the full RCA.

elaine: Legal: public posts must avoid customer identifiers and internal ticket IDs. Proposal for sharing policy:
- Public summary for Level A (major impact, >5% customers or paid tiers): anonymized public RCA + offer tailored addendum to impacted customers.
- Short public note for Level B (partial/perf): brief summary only; full RCA internal unless customer requests.
- Level C (ops/internal): internal-only RCA.

tony: I'll own posting the statuspage blurb within 24h. Mike, drop your draft in #incidents-drafts and I'll publish after a quick review.

mike: Posted draft: https://slack.redwood/drafts/1764123480

carolyn: Action items (owners/ETAs):
- Statuspage blurb: tony, 24h
- Short customer summary + sanitized template: mike + elaine, 48h / template 5d
- Full internal RCA + pattern analysis: sudha, 7d
- Legal confirmation of policy & regulator clause: elaine, 3d
- Recurring-pattern ticket + remediation backlog link: carolyn, 7d

ops-bot: Action created: INC-2026-457  RCA doc (internal) access restricted.

mike: Question: when a customer requests more detail, should support attach the internal doc or a sanitized version?

elaine: Always send a sanitized version. If a regulated customer or contract clause requires more, escalate to legal/sales for a tailored release.

sudha: Noted. I'll include recommended mitigations in RCA (Optimize suggestions + dedicated autoscale rules) if pattern confirmed.

ton y: Small wording note for status copy: avoid "we are investigating" unless it's still open. Use "we routed traffic to fallback capacity" or similar.

carolyn: Agreed. Using cautious, non-promissory language. Closing with confirmation: post status within 24h, targeted emails in 48h, sanitized public summary + next steps in 7d. Reopen thread if blockers. :thumbsup:
